name: Alien Worlds Framework
author: maevi
desc: Tired of always playing on the same boring earthlike worlds? So am I. This is a mod framework for creating entirely new types of planets, fully integrated with Worldbuilder.  Does not include any planet types on its own, check the linked steam collection for a few official ones.  <size=24>FAQ</size>  <size=16>What can this do that Worldbuilder can't?</size>  Worldbuilder is first and foremost a map creator. A mod can define the exact tiles/settlements/etc that should be generated, but it can't easily generate custom planets on the fly. This framework allows mods to do things like:  - Restrict which biomes should generate - Replace ocean tiles and textures, or remove oceans outright to have a fully solid world - Change the global average temperature to anything they want - And more!  All while keeping the vanilla world generation fully intact. Also note that while Worldbuilder has first-class support and I fully recommend using it, the mod can also work without it. In standalone mode, which planet type to generate can be selected in the mod's settings.  <size=16>Is this compatible with X?</size>  Most likely yes. I tested it with ~1200 mods and it worked perfectly well, but if you come across something that breaks please let me know.  <size=16>How can I create a custom planet type using this?</size>  Check the source code, documentation's all there: https://codeberg.org/maevi/rimworld-mods/src/branch/main/alien-worlds

desc: 添加战地5风格的击杀反馈效果。  特色功能： - 三层独立显示：击杀图标层、信息层（敌人名称+武器）、得分数字层。 - 两种显示模式：简洁模式（图标+敌人名称）和战地5经典模式（三层完整布局）。 - 爆头判定：击中头部且伤害足以致死时，触发专属橙色图标和扩散光圈特效。 - 流畅动画：图标弹入淡出，多连杀时动态重新排列。 - 高度自定义：通过游戏内设置可调整图标大小、间距、位置、显示时长、字体、基础得分等。 - 音效反馈：命中音效和击杀音效（可自定义）。  为追求更动态、更沉浸式战斗反馈的玩家打造。  Adds Battlefield 5 style kill feedback to RimWorld.  Features: - Three independent layers: Kill Icons, Info Text (enemy name + weapon), and Score Numbers. - Two display modes: Classic (icon + enemy name) and Battlefield 5 (full three-layer layout). - Headshot detection: Kills that hit the head and deal lethal damage trigger a special orange icon + expanding circle effect. - Smooth animations: Icons pop in, fade out, and dynamically reposition when multiple kills occur. - Fully customizable: Adjust icon size, spacing, positions, durations, fonts, base score, and more via in-game settings. - Sound effects: hit and kill sounds (customizable).  Perfect for players who want a more dynamic and immersive combat feedback experience.

name: Customize Room Role
author: LingLuo
desc: 语言:简体中文,英文   Language: Simplified Chinese, English   新增了一种建筑:门牌,你可以通过其控制当前房间的房间类型.   A new type of building has been added: doorplate, which allows you to control the room role of the current room    你是否受够了原版模糊不清的房间判断逻辑?是否难以忍受厨房放了个其他工作台就被错误识别?是否仅仅是因为想要在工作间放张床就被识别为卧室?是否因为卧室里多了几张无人睡眠的床就被识别为多人宿舍? ​如果你的答案是肯定的,那么也许你需要一张门牌,一张能够自定义房间类型的的门牌.使用它,你可以明确的指定对应的房间职能到底是卧室,厨房,或者工作间.帮助你避免原版下混乱不堪的判断逻辑,用一张门牌来跳过复杂的加权判断(这甚至可以优化性能). 当然,一个房间只能够放置一张门牌;如果你尝试在一个房间放置多个门牌的话,那么只会识别第一个建造的门牌;如果你试图把门牌放在室外,将整个世界定义为你的那房间,那么很遗憾门牌将不能生效.  Are you tired of the vague room assignment logic in the vanilla game? Frustrated when your kitchen gets misidentified just because another workbench is placed inside? Annoyed that your workshop is labeled a bedroom just because you added a bed? Or irritated when a bedroom with multiple unused beds is wrongly classified as a barracks?  If your answer is "yes," then perhaps you need a Room Sign—a customizable solution that lets you define room roles yourself. With it, you can explicitly designate a room as a bedroom, kitchen, workshop, or any other function. It helps you bypass the game’s convoluted weighted logic (and may even improve performance by simplifying calculations).  Of course, only one Room Sign is allowed per room. If you try to place multiple signs in one room, only the first one built will take effect. Also, if you attempt to place the sign outdoors—trying to declare the whole world as one room—it won’t work, unfortunately.

author: Enfants
desc: 【中文说明】  这是 LWOP 收尸机的独立版本，只包含收尸机建筑及其完整功能，不包含 LWOP Package 中的其他物品、建筑或系统。  主要功能： - 当地图上的敌对单位死亡后，距离死亡地点最近且处于启用状态的收尸机会自动回收尸体。 - 收尸机会同时回收死亡地点附近、符合自身储存筛选规则的掉落物和围攻物资。 - 不会主动搬走玩家现有仓库或储存区中的物品。 - 存放在收尸机中的可腐败物品会保持新鲜。 - 收尸机内的尸体、物品、拆卸建筑以及数量和品质文字不会覆盖建筑贴图。 - 支持多台收尸机；每次死亡事件由距离最近的有效收尸机负责处理。  兼容性： 本模组可以与完整的 LWOP Package 同时启用。检测到 LWOP Package 后，独立版会自动停用自己的建筑定义和 Harmony 补丁，由完整包中的收尸机接管，避免重复建筑、重复收尸和代码冲突。  如果想要体验完整的 LWOP 模组包，可以前往： https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2012717312   【English】  This is the standalone edition of the LWOP Corpse Collector. It includes the corpse collector building and all of its functionality, without any of the other items, buildings, or systems from LWOP Package.  Features: - When a hostile pawn dies on the map, the nearest active corpse collector automatically retrieves the corpse. - It also collects nearby dropped items and siege supplies that match its storage filter. - It does not remove items from existing player stockpiles or storage buildings. - Perishable contents stored inside the collector remain fresh. - Stored corpses, items, minified buildings, quantity labels, and quality labels are hidden so they do not cover the building texture. - Multiple corpse collectors are supported; each death event is handled by the nearest valid collector.  Compatibility: This mod can be enabled together with the full LWOP Package. When LWOP Package is detected, the standalone building definition and Harmony patches are automatically disabled, allowing the full package implementation to take over without duplicate buildings, duplicate collection events, or code conflicts.  To experience the complete LWOP mod package, visit: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2012717312

name: Personal Chronicle - Archive
author: Personal Chronicle Team
desc: 前置要求 - 游戏版本：RimWorld 1.6 - 必需依赖：Harmony（自动加载） - 语言：简体中文 / English  这是个啥 给殖民地请个「史官」，自动记录人物、物品、战役、地点，主界面底部「档案馆」按钮随时翻看。  都能干啥 - 总览：分类统计 + 最新事件流 + KPI 仪表盘，随时掌握殖民地动态。 - 分类浏览：人物 / 物品 / 战役 / 地点，一个都别想跑。 - 详情：时间轴 + 关联档案网络，谁摸鱼、谁背锅一目了然。 - 人物小传：生涯工时分档（核动力驴 / 超级牛马 / 常规牛马 / 劣质牛马 / 社会懒汉）、战斗履历、社会关系、足迹、健康残值。 - 检视面板：在 pawn 检视页签直接打开专属档案（v4.6）。 - 阵营图鉴（v4.3）、传承 / 所有权变更链（v4.7）、榨取总账、产出核销。  老板视角 本模组就是给你这尊「黑心老板」准备的：谁加班最多、谁划水最狠、谁惹了祸还甩锅，全记在小本本上。年终奖发不发另说，至少账算得门儿清。  接入说明 对外提供统一接入契约（PersonalChronicleApi 门面 + Provider 注册表），第三方模组可无侵入扩展采集与能力，Provider 异常失败隔离。API 契约版本 1.0，与发布版本号保持一致。  与 Character Editor 共存 本模组在 Languages/ChineseSimplified 下提供翻译文件的同时，已附带 LanguageInfo.xml 元数据，确保简体中文语言身份被正确识别。若同时启用 Character Editor，其编辑器窗口内的中文依赖游戏当前语言的 FriendlyNameEnglish；本模组不修改任何翻译系统，仅补全自身语言元数据以避免语言聚合时的回退命名冲突。如仍发现 CE 编辑器显示英文，请确认简体中文语言包（含 LanguageInfo.xml）已启用且加载顺序正确。  Personal Chronicle · 殖民地档案馆 · v1.1.4 · 国人开发  ---  Requirements - Game version: RimWorld 1.6 - Required dependency: Harmony (auto-loaded) - Languages: Simplified Chinese / English  What is this Hire a "court historian" for your colony. It auto-records pawns, things, battles and locations, and the "Archive" button on the main tab bar lets you flip through it anytime.  What it does - Overview: category stats + latest event feed + KPI dashboard. - Categories: pawns / things / battles / locations — nobody slips through. - Detail: timeline + relation network. Who slacked off, who took the blame, all in the book. - Pawn profile: career work-hours tier (Reactor Mule / Super Workhorse / Regular Workhorse / Poor Workhorse / Social Slacker), battle record, social relations, footprint, health valuation. - Inspect tab: open a pawn's archive directly from its inspect panel (v4.6). - Faction codex (v4.3), legacy / ownership chain (v4.7), exploitation ledger, output reconciliation.  Integration Ships a unified integration contract (PersonalChronicleApi facade + Provider registry) so third-party mods can extend capture and capabilities non-invasively, with per-provider failure isolation. API contract version 1.0, aligned with the mod version.  Coexistence with Character Editor This mod ships its translation files under Languages/ChineseSimplified together with a LanguageInfo.xml metadata file, so the Simplified Chinese language identity is recognized correctly. When Character Editor is also enabled, the Chinese text inside its editor window depends on the game's current language FriendlyNameEnglish; this mod does not alter any translation system — it only supplies its own language metadata to avoid fallback-naming conflicts during language aggregation. If CE's editor still shows English, make sure the Simplified Chinese language pack (with its own LanguageInfo.xml) is enabled and loaded in the correct order.  Personal Chronicle · Colony Archive · v1.1.4 · made by a Chinese dev

name: Research Reinvented
author: PeteTimesSix
desc: Consider inventing the humble mini-turret.  In vanilla Rimworld, the process is:     A colonist sits in front of a research table and stares at it for five weeks.   With Research Reinvented, the process can include any of the following:     Reverse engineer existing commandeered turrets.     See what you can learn from that ancient broken down security turret.     Analyse raw materials for their durability as turret armor.     Experiment with steel to figure out efficient barrel replacements.     Test out what modifications to the standard machine pistol or autopistol design might make for the best turret weapon.     Construct a prototype turret, even if it takes longer and the end product might need some fixing up right away. 	Ask allies to provide some of their expertise, or demand that information from your prisoners. 	Brainstorm solutions during social encounters between your colonists.  Taking advantage of such research opportunities can significantly accelerate your research progress. However, if none are available, the fallback Theory research is equivalent in speed to vanilla research (this speed can be lowered in the mod settings, if you'd prefer an incentive to seek opportunities out).

desc: "在边缘世界，没有什么比在因为没有桌子吃饭而发疯前，先刷两分钟短视频更重要的了。"  		📱 模组介绍 (Introduction) 		欢迎来到消费主义的边缘世界！RimDigital Life 为您的殖民地引入了一整套现代化的数码产品和生活方式。 这不仅仅是一堆贴图，而是一套完整的**“数码生态系统”**。您的殖民者现在可以使用智能手机、佩戴智能手表、在工作时间偷玩掌机，甚至组建昂贵的家庭影院游戏站。  		✨ 核心功能 (Features) 		1. 丰富的数码设备  		通讯终端：从坚不可摧的 Nokirim (诺基林) 到昂贵的 iShen (肾果) 全家桶（手机、平板、手表）。  		掌机娱乐：RiDS 双屏掌机、RSP 硬核掌机，以及次世代的 Riwitch 混合主机。  		主机游戏站：Rimbox 系列与 RimStation 系列，提供极致的娱乐体验（和极高的美观度）。  		电子阅读器：Rimdle，让书虫们在星际旅行中也能享受阅读的乐趣。  		2. 真实的“摸鱼”机制 (Slacking System)  		工作时间偷懒：殖民者在工作时会偶尔掏出手机或掌机“摸鱼”。  		风险与收益：摸鱼成功会获得心情加成（"偷个懒..."），但如果不幸被周围的同事或长官目击，就会**“被抓包”**并扣心情！  		完全可配置：觉得摸鱼太频繁？或者惩罚太轻？在 [选项 -> Mod 设置] 中，您可以自定义摸鱼概率、抓包半径，甚至开启**“严厉模式”**（被抓包直接击晕！）。  		3. 社交与互动  		📱 数码社交 (Digital Socializing)： 拒绝原本枯燥的聊天！佩戴手机的殖民者之间现在会通过 RimTalk 进行“语音通话”或“发送讯息”。你会看到专属的绿色聊天日志，感受在这个蛮荒星球上互发表情包的乐趣。远程通讯：佩戴通讯设备的小人之间会随机触发“电话聊天”事件（绿色日志），在这个孤独的星球上建立数字连接。  		数码慰藉：只要身上带着电子产品，现代人就会感到莫名的安心。  		4. 联动支持  		Digital Storage (数字存储)：完美支持！佩戴任意智能设备即可连接至数字存储网络。  		Save Our Ship 2 (SOS2/Odyssey)：专为星际旅行优化！在飞船上使用通讯设备会有额外的心情加成（毕竟太空中信号很珍贵）。  		🛠️ 设置菜单 (Mod Settings) 		本 Mod 提供详尽的设置面板，您可以调整：  		摸鱼触发频率 (0% - 100%)  		是否显示头顶气泡 (沉浸式体验)  		分心惩罚：开启后，携带电子设备会略微降低全局工作速度（硬核玩家专用）。  		📅 未来拓展计划 (Roadmap) 		目前的版本只是“边缘数码生活”的第一步，未来的更新计划包括：  		📡 运营商系统 (Carrier Expansion) 真正的远程通讯来了！建立信号基站，购买流量套餐。让您的小人随时随地掏出手机就能联络盟友、进行轨道交易，甚至在野外呼叫空中支援，不再受限于笨重的通讯台。  		💺 智慧办公 (Smart Office)  		人体工学椅、电动升降桌。  		为长时间伏案工作的科研人员提供健康保障。  		🛹 个人出行 (E-Mobility)  		电动平衡车、电动滑板。  		解决基地内通勤“最后一公里”的问题。  		⚠️ 前置需求 (Requirements) 		Harmony  		(可选) Digital Storage (推荐安装可以获得更有趣的存储体验) 		(可选) RimTalk (推荐安装可以启用智能助手 Rimi/Sirim 功能)  		👥 制作人员 (Credits) 		Code Art: Maiya0126 (麦丫Maiya)

name: RimHUD
author: Jaxe
desc:
Mod Version: 1.17.5

RimHUD is a UI mod that displays detailed information about a selected character or creature. The HUD display is integrated into the inspect pane which can be resized to fit the additional information. Alternatively, the HUD can display a separate floating window and can be docked to any position on the screen.

Visual warnings will appear if a pawn has any life-threatening conditions, has wounds that need tending to, or is close to a mental breakdown.

name: RimRelations
author: reo
desc: RimRelations adds a deeper social layer for colonies.  Pawns build separate bonds for liking, respect, trust, rivalry, anger, admiration, and protection. Real events such as rescue, treatment, harm, bonded animal harm, group reactions, small social moments, and sabotage can change those bonds and appear in relationship history. Strong nearby bonds can also provide small work and combat support rewards.  Use the Relations tab to inspect colony bonds, social circles, and recent relationship history. Settings are available in the mod settings menu.

name: RunAndGun - Continued
author: MemeGoddess
desc: Your colonists can never be a true Rambo if they cannot gun while they are running. Therefore, this mod adds a mode that, when enabled, allows drafted colonists to shoot while moving at the cost of an accuracy and movement penalty.These penalties can be modified in the mod settings of this mod. Some things to take into account: - Fire at will should be enabled. Firing manually will cause the pawn to stop running. - RunAndGun mode can only be enabled when the pawn is drafted, and is carrying a ranged weapon in its hands. - The movement penalty is only applied at the moment the pawn is actually shooting or cooling down after shooting. So don't bother disabling RunAndGun every time you just want your pawn to walk somewhere. Compatibility This mod should be compatible with existing saves, and removing the mod from saves shouldn't introduce problems. Moreover, this mod should be compatible with most other mods (including Combat Extended). However, keep in mind that this is hard to test for me by myself, and this is the first release. Therefore some issues regarding mod compatibility are bound to come up. Most issues that come up should be easy to fix, so please report any problems.

name: TradeHelper
author: TimmyLiang
desc: Trade Helper is a small tool which expands the Trading Dialog and helps you trade in RimWorld. This includes: - A Wish list: a configurable list of desired items, when a trader holds any matched items, these items will be clearly highlighted so you won't miss what you seek (especially handy when you are targeting certain goods). - Items to be bought: clearly displays the items you are buying. - Items to be sold: clearly displays the items you are selling (minimise the risk selling the wrong item). - Slightly enhanced the Trading Dialog (mouse hover highlights etc). - Enhanced the Caravan Dialog so it has similar features to the Trading dialog (updated 2020/06/02).  Compatability: - Should work with most MODs as this only tweaks the Trading/Caravan UI; - Work with existing saves; - Requires Harmony. - This Mod assumes your screen resolution is wider than 1300px as it adds 300px side space to the Trading/Caravan Dialogs.  Updates: - 2020/06/03: fixed a small display issue. - 2020/06/06: fixed a mod conflict. - 2020/08/15: now supports v1.2 (not tested with Royalty though). - 2020/08/16: fixed a conflict with mod RimThemes. - 2021/07/31: now supports v1.3 (not tested with DLC as I don't have). - 2022/10/22: now supports v1.4 (not tested with DLC as I don't have). - 2024/05/03: now supports v1.5 (I will test with DLC when I buy it). - 2025/07/11: now it should support v1.6 (but not heavily tested yet). name: Universal Blueprints
author: 白金trigger
desc: Universal Blueprints - The Ultimate Base Building Tool                      I. Four Core Features               1. Built-in Blueprint Browser               Comes with 101 highly practical blueprints, displayed by category and supported with a favorite function. You can browse blueprint information, check tech requirements, mod dependencies, and material needs, and click on images to zoom in for a closer look.                          2. Support Exporting Any Modded Buildings               Select an area to export buildings, and export XML data and images simultaneously, merged into a single PNG file for easy sharing. Supports all modded buildings, recording complete data such as 4-layer terrain data, building information, and roof information.                          3. Projection Display System               The projection layer is displayed independently without interfering with blueprint placement. You can place multiple projections on the map for planning; projections will show green when overlapping with existing buildings. Supports area-based projection deletion and projection switching.                              4. Red Badge Backup and Export Function               In Developer Mode, enabling God Mode will automatically generate physical buildings when placing blueprints. When selecting the "Export All Items" option in Developer Mode, it will export save-level building and item data, including roofs, roof areas, layered terrain, all items (durability, color, stack, quality), building colors, and lamp colors.               When the mod [Character Editor] is enabled, it additionally exports all character and animal data;               When the mod [[KV] Save Storage, Outfit, Crafting, Drug, Operation Settings] is enabled, it additionally exports storage areas, all building storage recipes, and all production building crafting recipes.               The red badge indicates full export mode, which exports almost all information and can only place complete buildings in God Mode.

name: Vanilla Cooking Expanded
author: Oskar Potocki, Sarg Bjornson, Chowder
desc: Vanilla Cooking Expanded is a core module in a brand new mod series “Vanilla Cuisine Expanded” from the Vanilla Expanded team, notably Sarg Bjornson, Oskar Potocki and Chowder. Whilst other mods work very well without it, Vanilla Cooking Expanded makes use of fish from Vanilla Fishing Expanded as well as plants from Vanilla Plants Expanded in order to provide users with a more in-depth cooking experience.  Mechanics are simple and intuitive - keeping within the vanilla spirit without the unnecessary fluff and production chains. Your colonists will be able to cook up a variety of new meal types, make mood boosting desserts out of fruits, make filling grilled meals that lose the effect when frozen, create large bakes using flour or produce large quantities of soup through boiling ingredients for several days at a time. Using our new system, you can now transform animal milk into cheese inside a cheese press - and it gains quality, and with that - value, the longer it’s inside! Yes, alongside Vanilla Factions Expanded - Medieval you can now create a cheese and wine empire! Hopefully this will provide one more reason to keep livestock!  Our systems are heavily moddable and support a variety of pre-existing mods. With Vanilla Factions Expanded - Insectoids you can now transform insectoid milk into insectoid cheese, and thanks to Sarg Bjornson, you can now utilise 19 (!) types of milk from Alpha Animals, Vanilla Genetics Expanded and Alpha Bees to create your cheese empire!  New ways of preserving food in the form of canning and deep frying, as well as a brand new condiment system will allow you to create not-so-filling gourmet meals that apply 12h long effects to people who consume them.

name: Vanilla Furniture Expanded
author: OskarPotocki, Atlas, Kikohi, Sarg, Sokyran
desc: I have always found vanilla furniture to be lacking in depth and quantity. After researching Complex Furniture, the research tree for furniture pretty much ends, with a couple of odd technologies adding things like Vitals Monitors and Hospital Beds along the way. As part of the Vanilla Furniture Expanded mod, the team consisting of the Author of Android Tiers, Atlas, and me would like to add some sort of progression to the furniture of the rim, whilst also keeping it Vanilla friendly.

name: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Architect
author: Oskar Potocki, xrushha, legodude17, ISOREX
desc: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Architect has been on my mind for a very long time. I always download every single mod adding new floors or fences, but I quickly become buried under all the new options, and eventually get pissed off because some of those options don't exactly fit Vanilla game in my eyes. 	 	I want new carpet colors, but I don't want all RGB hues - I want a small, tailored selection that fits the game. I want new tiles and floors, but I don't want 100 different patterns that have no distinction between them other than the looks. I want new fences, but I don't want more fence types than there are floor types. I want less, but I want more significant! 	 	Thus, Architect Expanded was born. Not only does it add new walls, fences, floors and carpets in various, vanilla-fitting colors, it also adds stone and metal bridges, as well as foundations that you can place on sand, so building in the desert will no longer be a problem! I seem to have forgotten to mention that wood now comes in 4 colors, all using just the base wood resource - so you can decide upon building what color your wooden objects will be! 	 	I really hope you will enjoy everything this mod has to offer, and it will allow you to make your colony at least twice as beautiful to look at.

name: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Art
author: Oskar Potocki, Sarg Bjornson
desc: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Art module is something long overdue. Being an artist, I struggled to comprehend why the only type of sculptures we can make are small, large or grand artworks on a tiny pedestal. It made Artistic skill pretty much undesirable. Come on, how many times have you said to yourself “Oh crikey, that’s another pawn that can only do art”?   A lot of people requested this mod on my Patreon so it’s about time I deliver. With this mod, your colony can create simple pottery from neolithic times, allowing you to gain some silver on the side to kickstart your base into the medieval era. Several new pieces of sculptures are available by the likes of small, large and grand statues, wall reliefs, decorative pillars and plinths that act both as an artwork and a shelf.  With industrial era your colony will be able to produce beautiful embroidered rugs to decorate those ugly floors! A new type of wall - wallpaper - is now also available, allowing you to put some colour onto your grim, broken walls. Spacer era features a new type of art called a hologram, emitting beautiful shade of blue light and using intellectual skill to determine the quality of it - however it does use up power!  And if that isn’t enough, a new type of quest reward is available - Archotech sculptures, not only being extremely beautiful and desirable, but also imprinting stunning imagery in the minds of surrounding colonists!

name: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Farming
author: Oskar Potocki, dninemfive, Kikohi, Sarg
desc: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Farming module is a great way to boost the efficiency of your colonies when it comes to providing food on the table. With a plethora of new hydroponics - one for early game and one for late game, you can really witness the technological progression of your colony - and gain more enjoyment from the game itself.  A very popular request on all suggestion threads on RimWorld Ludeon forums is draggable hydroponics - at this point I believe it’s my duty to deliver, hence all three kinds of hydroponics now have a draggable version! Make it any shape you want!  New structures by the likes of animal feeder, a sprinkler and a scarecrow have been added, each with unique code to make them feel more authentic. The scarecrow will actually make animals flee, hence stopping them from devouring all your precious potatoes!

name: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Medical Module
author: OskarPotocki, Atlas, Kikohi
desc: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Medical module adds several new pieces of furniture to allow players for higher variety of medical beds and linkables. Sterile walls have also been added with color-coded line markings, allowing users to color-code the rooms.

name: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Power
author: Oskar Potocki, Sarg Bjornson
desc: Vanilla power generation is somewhat lackluster late game - Not only the game strongly encourages the use of solar panels and wind turbines as they provide significantly more energy at the cost of no fuel, but it also stops there - there is no technological progression in regards to power. Whether you’re an early industrial colony, or a spacer super-empire (and we all like to roleplay different ways), you’re bound to use the same power sources.  Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Power module adds a plethora of new power sources, ranging all the way from small portable generators and large scale industrial ones, all the way to advanced spacer-tech green energy sources and a unique, and yet easy to understand nuclear generator. A selection of new batteries will help you with storing the power, whist the new utilities like a lightning rod and chemfuel pump will give you brand new ways of obtaining power and fuel.  A new, vanilla-fitting energy chain has been added in the form of helixien gas - a combustible substance found mostly on the planets on the galaxy rim. It can be used to power a vast array of new gas-operated structures, making them completely immune from solar flares! Helixien gas can be stored in gas tanks for later use, uses a gas pipe system for connecting to structures and can easily be turned into electricity using gas-operated generators!

name: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Production
author: Oskar Potocki, Trunken, Sarg
desc: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Production module, is an ideal mod to fill that late game hole in production. Once you set up your vanilla workstations with tool cabinets scattered everywhere, you essentially got as far as you possibly can. This carefully designed, vanilla-fitting mod adds a new layer to workstation layout, hopefully allowing players to create manufacturing-designated rooms instead of one massive room with all the workbenches.  Linkables: - Kitchen Sink Cabinet - Tailor Cabinet - Smithy Cabinet - Machining Cabinet - Drug Cabinet - Fabrication Cabinet  Workbenches: - Component Bench  - Fueled Smelter - Electric Butcher - Electric Drug Lab - Electric Stonecutter  Manufacturing: - Large Machining Table - Large Electric Smithy - Large Stove - Large Tailoring Table

name: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Security
author: Oskar Potocki, Sokyran, Taranchuk
desc: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Security is a complete overhaul and rebalance of the original security module, addressing outdated balance and vastly expanding defensive options from early to late game. The mod introduces new defenses across all tech levels:  - Medieval: Adds the catapults, cavalry spikes, ballistas and re-armable bear traps.  - Industrial: Expands automated turrets with the military turrets, flamer turrets, concealed barriers, shotgun turrets and more.  - Trench Warfare: Dugouts, trenches, platforms, razor wire and HMG and minigun complexes!  - Spacer: Charge turrets, charge complexes, railguns, tesla blasters and shockmines.  All original structures are rebalanced or reimplemented. Outstanding issues have been fixed. Existing content got new mechanics added, and new content has been implemented. Your beloved security mod is back, and better than ever!

name: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Spacer Module
author: OskarPotocki, Sokyran, Kikohi
desc: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Spacer gives your late-game colonies a proper high-tech upgrade. The old Spacer module was starting to feel a bit dated, so this overhaul adds slick, high-tech furniture that actually feels spacer-worthy: like advanced beds, illuminated furniture, modern couches, air purifiers, giant TVs, and more. It’s all balanced to fit naturally into your colony’s progression, and fully compatible with existing saves. If you want your futuristic colonies to look the part, this is the mod for you.

name: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Dryads
author: Oskar Potocki, Sarg Bjornson, Taranchuk, Reann Shepard
desc: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Dryads is a mod expanding on the selection of gauranlen dryads in the Ideology DLC. Whilst the idea behind them fulfilling the majority of the roles in your colony is neat, the current selection of dryads feels lackluster - they don’t particularly have any powerful abilities worth mentioning. This mod changes that - from new dryad types that fill roles not explored before, to upgrades to existing dryads, the whole gauranlen dryad system can finally become a focus point of the colony.  Integration with the Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Anima Theme also means that these new dryads get a reskin that suits Anima style if you have this mod active. This mod is meant to enhance Mr Samuel’s new Youtube series with some more dryad variety.

name: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Hats and Rags
author: Oskar Potocki, xrushha
desc: Vanilla Ideology Expanded is a mini-series of mods aimed at expanding the content in ideology - be it memes, relics and symbols or icons alike.  This mod introduces many new headgear types and one new outfit type for your ideological pawns. No longer you will be limited by the selected few new headwraps and burkas for your Role generation - your leaders will now be able to wear amazing new headgear such as Horse mask or fez, while moralists will adorn themselves in rags, similar to those of typical monks.  On top of that, Vanilla Apparel Expanded apparel is also patched with this mod, allowing it to be desired by ideologies or specific roles! Of course it doesn’t mean it’s random or anything, on the contrary, you can now expect that your shooting specialists might require military apparel, while medical specialists will want to wear medical scrubs.  In case of any feedback or bug reports, please utilise the comment section of the mod on the Steam workshop.

name: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Relics and Artifacts
author: Oskar Potocki, Sarg Bjornson, legodude17
desc: This mod adds another 40 'useless' relic items like Chalice, Ark or Shard in Ideology DLC. You can now find Shards of a Sword, mechanoid head, Mysterious orb and many, many more. Furthermore, this mod unlocks all the apparel in the game from being unable to spawn as relics, which means your colonists might now find holy power armor helmets or sacred boots. This should greatly enhance ideologies generated by the game.

name: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Sophian Style
author: Oskar Potocki, Sarg Bjornson
desc: This mod introduces a brand new style, inspired by that of the Empire from Royalty DLC. Featuring numerous new textures for many structures and weapons in the game, this mod also features built-in interactions with many of the Vanilla Expanded mods, changing furniture from Vanilla Furniture Expanded, or weapons from Vanilla Weapons Expanded, to interesting, new and unique empire-themed versions. 	 	The existence of a brand new ritual sound and ritual effects displaying the beautiful imperial banners waving in the wind will ensure that you get filled with pride every time you execute dissidents and deserters. Fallen Empire faction will be guaranteed to spawn with this ideological style.

name: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Splits and Schisms
author: Oskar Potocki, Taranchuk
desc: The goal of this mod is to add a new mechanic to make ideologies a bit more of a gameplay affecting challenge, as well as introduce a new form of threat that needs to be countered by the player once the colony is big enough.  Ideologies, while docile and strong in small societies, often tend to divide larger societies. The more people there is, the more ideologies differ. This mod introduces an Ideological Schism, which is an event in which a new ideology emerges in some percent of your colonists. In a way, the new ideology is very much similar to what the base ideology is, except for one or two different memes.  This will result in a player having two unique ideologies in one colony, both struggling to become dominant. Once one of the two ideologies completely vanishes, a new schism can occur.

name: Vanilla Melee Modes
author: Aliza
desc: Vanilla Melee Modes - Selectable melee modes with parry and counterattack for vanilla melee combat

name: Vanilla Vehicles Expanded
author: Oskar Potocki, xrushha, Smash Phil, Taranchuk, Reann Shepard, Sarg
desc: Vanilla Vehicles Expanded is a long awaited mod utilising Smash Phil’s Vehicles framework. The main purpose of the mod is to add realistic and engaging mechanics surrounding vehicles of all kinds into the game. Not just the cars, but boats and airplanes too, this mod comes packed full of content and new production chains to allow players to dive deep into the vehicle production. 	 Vehicles come separated into many different categories and tiers, contributing to the overall progression. You won’t simply be making a car and driving it around - you will keep checking out other vehicles and options this mod brings to the table. Every car, boat and aircraft will have a particular purpose and thanks to the tier system, it will be easy to understand the differences between various vehicles.  This mod utilises the paint job system added in Vehicles framework, allowing you to fully customize the pattern and colors of each of your vehicles. Whether you want a camouflaged armored division, or a pink bomber wing, this mod has it all.

name: Vehicle Framework 载具框架 简繁汉化包
author: Shavius
desc: 注意：本mod只是框架，并不包含任何可用载具  万众瞩目的载具框架终于制作成熟了，它几乎从无到有地建立起了一整套载具独属的系统，让制作者仅通过xml就能制作真实合理的载具。 载具能拥有自己的属性，部件血量，操作员，动力源。既可以作为一个多格物体在小地图中自由寻路，还可以被编入远行队在世界地图上旅行。

name: Vehicle Map Framework
author: OELS
desc: This mod is a framework mod for vehicles using Vehicle Framework to put a map on vehicle which floors and buildings can be constructed. このModはVehicle Frameworkを使用した車両に、床や建築物を建設可能なマップを載せるためのフレームワークMODです。 這個模組是 **Vehicle Framework** 的擴展，讓車輛能夠變成一張可建造的地圖，你可以在上面蓋地板、建築，打造屬於自己的移動基地！

name: Warehouse Storage
desc: A mod that aims to make some of the storage objects in various ancient ruin mods useable as storage container using the Adaptive Storage Framework.

name: Weapon Mastery
author: Sk
desc: Adds a new simple weapon mastery mechanic into the game. Pawns use the same weapon for a decent amount of time, naturally they should start getting better at handling/using said weapon. This mod adds a new hidden skill that levels up as pawns use their weapons (similar to shooting/melee). Pawns will gradually receive some minor randomized bonuses from mastering weapons and will also rename their weapon for sentimental value.

name: Weapon Upgrade
author: LotusLand
desc: Merge some weapons to craft a better quality weapon

name: Who shot my leg off?
author: Tixiv
desc: A quality of life mod for Rimworld  Did you ever notice that your colonist had a scar or a missing body part, and you just asked yourself: How did that happen? This mod will solve that problem. Now what happened and when it occurred will be displayed on each Hediff (health condition) forever.  The funny thing is: Rimworld actually already has this feature somewhat built in, since Heddifs already save the log string, and the timestamp when they occurred forever. However the log entry isn't displayed in the Hediff anymore after it has been purged from the battle log of the pawn, which might actually be a game bug or oversight. The nice thing is that this means the data is already there in savegames, so this mod will also work on injuries that occurred before it was installed!  Additionally to fixing this game oversight, this mod also displays when the Hediff occurred right in the Hediff itself. No need to click to the battle log anymore!  Compatibility: Absolutely no issues expected. This mod patches only the function that get's the battle log entry on a Hediff. That really shouldn't interfere with anything. The mod is also safe to remove at any time.

name: XML Extensions简繁中文汉化
author: asavikle
desc: [h1][b]XML Extensions的简繁中文汉化包，请在原mod之后加载。[/b][/h1]  	翻译： 	-简中：asavikle 	-繁中：asavikle 	 	[h1]简介：[/h1] XML Extensions是一个框架和建模工具，它专注于扩展XML mods的一般功能。这个框架添加了更多的补丁操作，允许在XML中轻松创建mod设置，等等。    更多补丁操作  XML扩展包括许多新的补丁操作，供修改者使用。这些操作更加强大和动态，允许您基本上使用XML进行编程；您可以访问if语句、for循环、数学运算等。    在XML中创建Mod设置  有了XML扩展，您可以轻松地为您的mod创建mod设置，全部使用XML！您可以使用这些设置来切换修补程序操作、更改修补程序操作中的值，或者在C#中使用它们来执行其他操作。    使用XML扩展的Mod设置位于“更多Mod设置”下。    增强的XML错误报告功能  当XML扩展处于活动状态时，所有XML修补程序错误现在也将生成堆栈跟踪！这意味着您可以准确地找出哪个修补程序失败了，在某些情况下，它甚至会告诉您修补程序的哪个部分失败了。您所需要做的就是在测试mod时在modlist中激活XML扩展。   ——————————————————————————    漏译问题：因为个人水平有限，可能有些汉化漏译错译，如果出现这种情况，请务必反馈给我。  ——————————————————————————    關於繁體中文：由於是使用簡體中文的語言環境，所以漢化包中的繁體中文是基於簡體中文利用軟件轉換而來的。可能有部分語法問題或者部分名詞與繁體中文的官方漢化名詞不對應（比如thrumbo，簡體中文翻譯是敲擊獸，繁體中文翻譯是獨角獸）。如有這種情況，歡迎使用繁體中文的朋友參與進來，將繁體中文中的錯誤修復後打包發給我，我們將進行替換並添加你為共同作者。

name: Yet another Optimizer
author: szszss
desc: YetAnotherOptimizer is a high-performance optimization mod for RimWorld. It is designed to significantly increase game frame rates (both FPS and TPS) and make the late-game colonies run smoother.

name: 人物随机名称池
author: Codex + User
desc: 三模式中文人物命名池（全随机 / 黄巢 / 半随机），支持派系级开关、自定义姓氏、锁定随机池、批量随机/原版与冲突重随机。随机池与批量数量可记忆；统一显示格式：姓 '姓名' 名。姓名文件位于模组 NameData 目录。 / Three-mode Chinese pawn name pool (Full Random / Huangchao / Semi-Random) with per-faction toggles, custom surnames, random-pool lock, batch Random/Vanilla actions, and conflict-aware reroll. Random pools and batch count are persisted. Unified display format: Surname 'SurnameGiven' Given. Name files are in the mod's NameData folder.

name: 巴尔：文化与信仰
author: 想成为作家的厨师
desc: [h1]巴尔：文化与信仰[/h1] [b]RimWorld 1.6｜需要 Ideology DLC｜纯 XML｜不需要 Harmony[/b]  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  在边缘世界中建立属于巴尔传统的宗教与公民文化。  本模组依据《五肢与双眸》《幽纱神乌诺勒雅》《巴尔通史》与《正衡录》，为 Ideology 加入完整的宗教结构、文化形态、戒律、年度仪式、意识形态预设和建筑美术。内容重视人格平等、公共责任、劳动组织、可复核之法，以及对死者与失踪者的寻找和复名。  [h2]◆ 三种结构：两种宗教，一种世俗[/h2]  [list] [*][b]五肢与双眸[/b]：世界是母神活着的躯体。日月双眸、过去与未来、承担责任的当下、耕作与工艺构成七相；每个人都是同一躯体上感知痛苦的神经。 [*][b]幽纱归流[/b]：乌诺勒雅既非死亡，也不审判死亡。她见证记忆、自我认识与归流，要求寻找、辨认、追问缘由、归还姓名并尽力修补，但不强迫宽恕。 [*][b]巴尔世俗公民主义[/b]：世上没有神明；公共制度只接受平等人格、历史经验、物质条件与可公开复核的理由。神明数量固定为 0。 [/list]  为避免原版要求世界中神名全局唯一而产生重名错误，两种结构会以“正典名＋地方尊号”组合显示神名，同时保留七相与乌诺勒雅的设定身份。  [h2]◆ 12 种文化形态[/h2]  [b]六种核心形态[/b]  正衡平权、巴尔民契共和主义、第三火共产主义、公仓共益、可复核之法、归流守名。  [b]六种扩展路线[/b]  巴尔人民之契、巴尔公民民粹主义、合作社共同体、劳动团结、联邦公社自治、公共教育与知识。  这些形态带有组合约束、专属戒律、仪式与克制的属性修正。“巴尔人民”由共同居住、公民民契和共有制度界定，不以血统或异种类型划界。共和主义、第三火共产主义与公民民粹主义是三条互斥的现代政治路线，并且只能与无神结构组合。  [h2]◆ 25 条专属戒律[/h2]  戒律覆盖公民平等、公职任期、紧急权力到期、劳动者议会、公共基础设施、公民身份、姓名归属、公众授权、请愿与罢免、合作社、劳动安全、互助救济、地方自治、公共档案、教育与知识共享等议题。  每项戒律都是独立卡片，不占用普通戒律数量上限；部分戒律提供少量社交、谈判、工作、种植、建造、研究、学习或医疗修正。数值刻意保持温和，重点仍是意识形态组合与叙事风味。  [h2]◆ 6 个专属年度仪式[/h2]  [list] [*][b]双灯誓[/b]：在公开真相与受保护的复原之间承担责任； [*][b]三问守夜[/b]：追问发生之事、权力缘由与仍可进行的修补； [*][b]众议会[/b]：听取报告、提出异议并重申公众托付； [*][b]第三火共灶会[/b]：共同守火、分享谷物并纪念平等人格； [*][b]衡麦分种[/b]：分享种源、储备、工艺知识与安全经验； [*][b]归流点名[/b]：诵读死者、失踪者、无名者与复名者的姓名。 [/list]  仪式只由对应的巴尔形态或宗教结构加入，不会随机散布到无关理念中。  [h2]◆ 20 个意识形态预设[/h2]  [list] [*][b]12 个原版分类预设[/b]：4 个温和、7 个激进、1 个极端，覆盖全部十二种文化形态； [*][b]8 个巴尔传统完整预设[/b]：正衡共和国、第三火共产主义公社、七相共责会、乌诺勒雅守名者、巴尔公民公议会、第三火工人共和国、巴尔合作社联邦、巴尔公共知识共同体。 [/list]  可直接选择完整路线，也可以在 Ideology 编辑器中自行组合。  [h2]◆ 两套宗教建筑美术[/h2]  “七相神躯”与“幽纱归流”各提供 8 个原版建筑样式：小型／大型／宏伟神像、四档祭坛以及地面圣徽，共计 [b]16 个 ThingStyle[/b]。选择对应宗教结构后，原版宗教建筑会自动采用巴尔造型。  另有两座原生可建造的正式祭坛：  [list] [*][b]双灯七相坛[/b]（3×2）：用于五肢与双眸结构的双灯誓； [*][b]幽纱归名龛[/b]（2×2）：用于幽纱归流结构的三问守夜。 [/list]  两座建筑沿用原版祭坛的仪式目标、房间归属与建造逻辑。  [h2]◆ 独立图标体系[/h2]  3 种结构与 12 种文化形态使用彩色巴尔纹章；25 项戒律使用 128×128 白色剪影图标，与原版 Ideology 的轮廓语言保持一致。两种宗教结构另有完整的祭坛、神像、圣徽与方向纹理；世俗结构不注入宗教建筑画风。  [h2]◆ 机制边界[/h2]  本模组没有 C#。戒律中的选举、任期、罢免、共同治理等内容通过原版 Ideology 的文字、组合约束、仪式与小幅属性效果表达；[b]不会暗中增加真正的投票、定期选举、自动罢免、共同库存或工时法律系统[/b]。众议会等仪式复用原版年度聚会行为。  “第三火共产主义”是巴尔传统在工业时代后的共产主义支派，并非《正衡录》的原始主张；更接近正典公共经济的是“公仓共益”。  共和主义、第三火共产主义与公民民粹主义现在是三条互斥路线。三者都排斥巴尔与原版的有神／泛灵／理想神／宗教源流结构；在原版与巴尔模组范围内，只能搭配神明数量为 0 的原版“意识形态”或“巴尔世俗公民主义”。第三方模组自行新增的宗教结构只有采用相同排斥标记时才会受此约束。  [h2]◆ 依赖、语言与存档[/h2]  [list] [*][b]游戏版本[/b]：RimWorld 1.6 [*][b]必需 DLC[/b]：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1392840/RimWorld__Ideology/]Ideology[/url] [*][b]Harmony[/b]：不需要 [*][b]代码与框架[/b]：纯 XML，不依赖第三方种族或代码框架 [*][b]语言[/b]：完整简体中文；英文基础文本 [/list]  请将本模组放在 Core 与 Ideology 之后。现有意识形态不会被强制重写；旧档里已经保存的“共和／共产／民粹叠加有神结构”仍会原样保留。可在开发者模式的意识形态编辑，或下一次流体意识形态改革中，只保留三条现代路线之一并改用“巴尔世俗公民主义”。新建意识形态和新世界会直接遵守新规则。首次加入重要旧档前请备份；已经引用本模组 Def 的存档不建议中途移除本模组。  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ name: 通用义体兼容 (Universal Implant Compatibility)
author: ZuoYao
desc: 【模组简介】 为RimWorld的手术与义体系统进行了一次彻底的底层重构，使其能够支持多义体共存。而且能够一个个移除。是的，我覆盖了原版直接去除bodypart的手术逻辑，改为去除hediff，这样就可以一个个移除义体了！这样，任何Mod添加的义体（仿生体/植入物），现在都可以和谐共存于同一个身体部位，再也不用做残酷的“二选一”了！  【核心特性】 1. “我全都要” —— 无限共存： 在同一个手臂上同时安装仿生臂、高级仿生臂和超凡仿生臂？没问题！都赛博超人了，三头六臂又如何？只要是基于 Hediff_AddedPart 系统的义体，都能完美叠加。  2. “叠叠乐” —— 属性累积： 所有共存义体的身体部件效率（例如操作能力 110% * 120% = 132%！）、特殊能力加成、统计数值修改均会自动叠加计算。越装越强，磁场转动一百万匹，干爆整个天下呀！  3. “微创手术” —— 精准移除： 彻底重写了原版粗暴的手术逻辑。现在，移除义体就像精密拆弹一样，你可以从一个部位上的多个义体中，精准选中并移除某一个，而不会导致其他义体弹出，更不会导致小人因器官缺失而暴毙。  【安全机制】 系统会阻止你在同一部位安装两个完全一模一样的义体（比如两个普通仿生心脏）。在最后一个仿生体被移除时，会自动补上原版部件，不会导致突然截肢或死亡。  常见问题：  Q：可以中途加入存档吗？ A：当然可以。本模组不修改任何存档结构，只是让游戏“学会”了处理多义体的情况。中途加入立刻生效，中途移除也不会炸档（多余义体会作为物品自动退还）。  Q：支持 XX 义体模组吗？ A：只要那个模组使用的是游戏标准的义体定义（Hediff_AddedPart），那就 100% 支持。无论是 EPOE、Archotech Expanded，还是各种种族模组自带的义体，统统拿下。  Q：支持 CE 吗？ A：必须的。本模组只涉及手术逻辑与健康状态管理，不触碰战斗伤害计算的核心代码，与 CE（Combat Extended）完美兼容。  Q：为什么我不能安装两个一模一样的仿生腿在同一条腿上？ A：重复安装完全相同的义体容易在数据层面引发混乱，我能力有限，无法保证其稳定性。  代码：我自己 封面：我自己  特别注意： -本模组完全由本人制作，没有任何其他我未提及的作者的协助，禁止未经授权的转载和用于AI训练。 -本模组的代码不开源，如果您希望进行二次创作，需要获得我的明确授权。 -当然，我很欢迎互相交流进步，这只是一个提醒，我不想之前的事情再次发生了。如果有兴趣，请务必和我联系。

name: 青的更多特性2【Qing's.More.Traits 2】
author: 青茗
desc: [h1][b]版本：1.0[/b][/h1]   [i]machine translation：This mod is only available in Chinese at present, I don't know any other languages, if you want to release other language packs, please feel free, there is no need to inform me[/i]   [h1]──────────────── 作者的话 ────────────────[/h1] 非常感谢大家的支持，我们的mod已经出到第二部了。非常荣幸能够得到大家的喜爱，在第一部中就已经有了很多的订阅以及反馈和新的建议。在这个底层被完全重置的第二代中（显然无法与第一代共用），新添加了很多新的机制以及有趣的内容。并且在信息显示层面无论是UI还是文字提示都有了长足进步，trigger大佬的帮助以及一些工坊内做出mod范例的诸位和玩家。  这本质上是一个由我个人参考了诸多特性mod后所创作的特性合集，以供我的个人游玩。由于我不太喜欢玩梗或是与出戏很明显的特性包，又觉得原版的特性比较少，所以这个特性包在摸索过一阵后终于出现了。[spoiler]不过这并不能符合所有人的胃口，请按照自己的需求添加[/spoiler]   [h1]──────────────── 主要内容 ────────────────[/h1] 非常感谢大家的支持，我们的mod已经出到第二部了。非常荣幸能够得到大家的喜爱，在第一部中就已经有了很多的订阅以及反馈和新的建议。在这个底层被完全重置的第二代中（[b][u]显然无法与第一代共用[/u][/b]），新添加了很多新的机制以及有趣的内容。并且在信息显示层面无论是UI还是文字提示都有了长足进步，大佬的帮助以及一些工坊内做出mod范例的诸位和玩家。  [h1]──────────────── 关于DLC ────────────────[/h1] [b][u]注意：部分特性效果可能需要加载DLC，如果无DLC或DLC不全可能会报错。如果你实在不想使用dlc内容，你可以载入后在开启新档时可以关闭新内容，比如使用经典版本游玩（相当于不使用文化dlc），禁止异象生成（相当于不使用异象）...但你必须启用它们[/u][/b]  - 皇权：必须加载 - 文化：必须加载，但可以不使用 - 生物科技：必须加载 - 异象：必须加载，但可以不使用 - 奥德赛：可以不加载，但是会少一部份特性和机制  [h1]──────────────── 内容表格 ────────────────[/h1]  [table] [tr] [td][b]特性等级[/b][/td] [td][b]特性数量[/b][/td] [td][b]刷新率[/b][/td] [td][b]价格影响[/b][/td] [/tr]  [tr] [td]劣等 (B)[/td] [td] x18 [/td] [td]15%[/td] [td]-30%[/td] [/tr]  [tr] [td]普通 (N)[/td] [td] 35 [/td] [td]60%[/td] [td]无[/td] [/tr]  [tr] [td]稀有 (R)[/td] [td] 54 [/td] [td]20%[/td] [td]+30%[/td] [/tr]  [tr] [td]史诗 (SR)[/td] [td] 20 [/td] [td]10%[/td] [td]+60%[/td] [/tr]  [tr] [td]传说 (SSR)[/td] [td] 20 [/td] [td]3%[/td] [td]+100%[/td] [/tr]  [tr] [td]异常 (UR)[/td] [td] 11 [/td] [td]＜1%[/td] [td]+150%[/td] [/tr] [/table]   [h1]──────────────── 强度说明 ────────────────[/h1]  通常来说单个特性的表现不会过于超模，除非你开局捏超人，很多相性特性组合起来有超模效果，但越强的特性通常角色的附加价值较高，但是出现几率也越小，算是一种软平衡。有部分特性因其有较强的负面效果都需要为其搭配一些玩法才能体现强度。整体游玩体验就是一整局不会看到太多红色特性（除非你很幸运），橙色为常规优质特性相对稀有，而紫色/蓝色基本是队伍的主流。因增加了人物价值，对于压财富比较困难，故此初期是比较负正义的[spoiler]加一些负面特性能显著降低人物价值[/spoiler][spoiler]在二代中因为新的机制的加入所以强度会比原版要高[/spoiler]    希望你游玩这个mod玩得开心，本mod依旧在制作中后续仍会添加新的特性，所以如果有任何建议和意见可以告诉我，反馈bug记得带上你的红字以及产生bug的情节，说的细致一些，否则我不知道如何复现。   [h2]其中一些问题自检方式(包括，但不限于本mod)[/h2]  1.完全关闭mod只开我这一个（甚至不开mod）,但仍然报错说明你可能是残留的配置问题（部分模组更新时可能会出现），请备份并删除C:\Users\你的用户名\AppData\LocalLow\Ludeon Studios\RimWorld by Ludeon Studios\Config中的配置文件，然后重启确定无红字（如果你看不到以上任意一个文件夹，请确保你能看得到隐藏的项目，在标题栏上方查看→显示→隐藏的项目）  2.取消订阅，并重新下载本mod  3.按照报错信息，删除出问题的特性再添加（需角色编辑器，或类似mod/控制台），特性命名均为QING_(名称拼音首字母，应该很好查找)  4.大部分特性是xml，少部分机制写在dll里应该不会有恶性bug，有能力的可以自己改文件，我的文件分划应该还是比较清晰的，当然也欢迎参考   [h2]常见问题[/h2] 消息弹个不停：1.自己用角色编辑器点掉状态，让他们自己生成一次 2.或者设置页面关掉消息

name: Custom Weapons Expanded
author: Feliperathal
desc: Custom Weapons Expanded expands the Customize Weapon framework with new modules, ammunition types, weapon traits, on-use abilities, and built-in compatibility patches for a large collection of weapon packs.  Plan weapon builds before spending resources with the weapon preview and module planning window. Search and filter compatible modules, preview appearance and stat changes, check crafting and research requirements, save assembly presets, and create crafting bills directly from the planner.  New customization options include utility under-barrel launchers, muzzle devices, light and heavy receivers, specialized magazines, Eltex components, arrow payloads, uranium and erosion ammunition, and module sets for gauss, rail, laser, and plasma weapons. Some modules require their respective RimWorld DLC or supported content mod.  Includes Combat Extended compatibility and ready-to-use patches for many popular weapon, faction, race, and exploration mods.  Requires Customize Weapon and RimWorld 1.6.

name: Cyberware 2077
author: EveningSky
desc: Adds a variety of different cyberware implants from Cyberpunk 2077 (2.0+)  Update 1.5.0: Added Monowire. Highly accurate melee arm implant which deals cutting and EMP damage. Great for countering Sandevistan/Cyberdeck/Relic users and mechanoids in melee, if you can hit them. Berserks are not susceptible to EMP, however Berserk users that also have Relics installed will still suffer from the Relic's EMP debuff. On that note, Cyberdeck, Relic, and INACTIVE Sandevistan EMP debuffs were nerfed. However, an ACTIVE sandevistan will crash if hit by an EMP, capping consciousness at 75%. On the other hand, good luck hitting an active sandevistan user in the first place.  This is not a replacement for mods like [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1949064302]EPOE[/url], instead it's meant to work alongside those mods. Almost all cyberware implants can be installed alongside normal implants/prosthetics. They typically offer powerful combat-related buffs, but also come at a cost to the user's mental state. Happier and more mentally stable pawns will be able to safely handle more cyberware than unhappy or unstable pawns.  ISSUES: See KNOWN ISSUES at the bottom  Current features: For a full list of cyberware with stats/descriptions, see this Google doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1s99r-F8rQR9USSISSjN1P02jSIKfGt_IfwIAp7cyCb0/edit?usp=sharing  --------------------------------------------------  Operating Systems: Only one may be installed. For extra Operating System slots, use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3491012624]Multi-OS Patch[/url]  -------------------- - Chrome Compressor: A type of OS cyberware that reduces mental impact, allowing the user to tolerate more cyberware. -------------------- - Sandevistan: A class of OS cyberware, giving the user the ability to increase their mental and physical speed. The user sees everything in slow motion but feels like they're moving at normal speed. To everyone else, it looks like they're moving faster. While these increase aiming speed and decrease cooldowns, they do not increase cyclic rate of automatic weapons, and these may not be worth using with higher-speed sandevistans. --- Zetatech sandevistan --- Dynalar sandevistan --- QianT "Warp Dancer" sandevistan --- Militech "Falcon" sandevistan --- Militech "Apogee" sandevistan -------------------- - Berserk: A class of OS cyberware, giving the user the ability to enter a primal rage state that temporarily decreases damage taken, but only allows the use of melee weapons. --- Moore Tech berserk --- BioDyne berserk --- Zetatech berserk --- Militech berserk -------------------- - Cyberdeck: A class of OS cyberware, giving the user access to powerful offensive Quickhacks that directly affect targets. --- Militech Paraline --- Biotech Sigma --- Raven Microcyber --- Arasaka Shadow --- Tetratronic Rippler --- Netwatch Netdriver --- Militech Canto --------------------------------------------------  General Cyberware implants: A class of 27 different cyberware implants, all fully intercompatible with all other implants. Most of these offer powerful stacking buffs, increasing attack speed, accuracy, melee damage, hit chance, dodge chance, armor, or movement speed. Some are meant to build upon others' boosts. Some might grant an ability. Install as many as you want, the only limit is your mental state.  -------------------- -Nervous System: --- Stabber --- Visual Cortex Support --- Neofiber --- Kerenzikov -------------------- -Frontal Cortex: --- Memory Boost --- Ex-Disk --- Kerenzikov Boost System -------------------- -Circulatory System: --- Biomonitor --- Microrotors --- Clutch Padding --- Blood Pump -------------------- -Integumary System: --- Subdermal Armor --- Proxishield --- Optical Camo --- Pain Editor --- Chitin -------------------- -Skeleton: --- Bionic Joints --- Titanium Bones --- Dense Marrow --- Rara Avis -------------------- -Hands (fully compatible with bionic arms): --- Handle Wrap --- Shock Absorber --- Ballistic Coprocessor --- Immovable Force -------------------- -Legs (fully compatible with bionic legs): --- Fortified Ankles --- Leeroy Ligament System --- Jenkins' Tendons --------------------------------------------------  Body part replacements: These are installed like normal bionic arms and eyes.  -------------------- -Arms: High-quality cyberarm replacements with increased durability, giving them an edge over the competition. Sometimes, literally. Manipulation capacity is between Archotech arms and EPOE's Advanced Bionic arms, though you might find the combat bonuses make them better than both. --- Gorilla Arms --- Mantis Blades --- Higurashi 20-13 Mantis Blades --- Projectile Launch System --- Monowire -------------------- -Eyes: Kiroshi optics are high-quality products, offering increased resiliency and performance over their competitors' products. Sight capacity is between Archotech eyes and EPOE's Advanced Bionic eyes, though you might find the combat bonuses make them better than both. --- Kiroshi "Stalker" eyes --- Kiroshi "Doomsayer" eyes --- Kiroshi "The Oracle" eyes --------------------------------------------------  The Relic 3.0: Dramatically improves user's mental state, allowing them to easily tolerate extreme amounts of cyberware, at the cost of becoming totally psychically deaf. Requires an AI persona core.  --------------------------------------------------  I did my best to try to keep things faithful to the original game while retaining some semblance of balance. Certain implants have also had their functions swapped in a way that made more sense to me.  Made for use with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2890901044]Combat Extended[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1665403571]Elite Bionics Framework[/url], but it should work fine without them. Also integrating compatibility with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3392321810]a mod that basically adds Cyberpsychosis[/url].  I would also like to offer thanks to 004GP for making [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2106586652]Internal Armor Plates Standalone[/url], as his mod formed the basis for the armor enhancing effects in this one.  KNOWN ISSUES:  Implants are replacing entire bodies!!! (e.g. the Torso): --- Known to be caused by using saves from an older version of this mod (V# 1.1 or earlier). If this is popping up, please use this forked version of the mod: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3493998996]Cyberware 2077 - Limited Slots Version[/url]. Please note: This version of the mod will have limited future support. It may become a patch later on, requiring this main mod file.  Melee dodge chance is insanely high!!!: --- Caused by VCR. Has nothing to do with this mod.  This is a newish mod, so please expect and report bugs.

name: ISEKAI RPG LEVELING
author: Jelly Creative
desc: ISEKAI RPG LEVELING SYSTEM  -  v1.1.7  Your pawns have been transported to the Rim... but they brought something special with them - the ability to level up like heroes from another world!  CORE FEATURES - RPG Stats: STR, DEX, VIT, INT, WIS, CHA - allocate stat points on level up - XP System: Gain XP from combat, crafting, research, social, and more - Rank System: F, E, D, C, B, A, S, SS, SSS ranks with unique bonuses - Combat Auras: High-rank pawns (B+) display colorful energy auras in combat - Aura Pressure: S-rank and above unleash a crushing aura that collapses weaker foes - Mood Thoughts: Pawns react to levelling, ranking up, forging, and battle - Mob Ranking: All creatures ranked by power - fight stronger foes for more XP - Mana Core Drops: Enemies drop valuable mana cores based on their rank - Rank Traits: Social bonuses and roleplay flavor based on power level - Psycast Integration: WIS affects neural heat, psychic sensitivity, and more  STAT EFFECTS - STR: Melee damage, carry capacity - VIT: Health regen, damage reduction, armor, rest rate - DEX: Move speed, dodge, accuracy - INT: Research speed, learning speed, work speed - WIS: Mental stability, medical skill, animal handling, psycast abilities - CHA: Social impact, trade prices, tame chance, arrest success  COMBAT AURAS (B-Rank and above) - B Rank: White/Silver - A Rank: Blue - S Rank: Gold - SS Rank: Orange/Red - SSS Rank: Violet/Purple - Auras grow with rank in both size and density, and rotate around the pawn - Every pawn shows the default flame aura; per-class Constellation auras are   an optional choice in each pawn's Status tab  AURA PRESSURE (S-Rank and above) - A Conqueror's aura that collapses every weaker non-allied creature in range - Equal or higher ranks resist it completely; your colony and allies are never hit - Reach grows with rank: 19 tiles at S, 28 at SS, 38 at SSS - The weaker the target, the longer they stay down (never lethal) - Hostile S-rank enemies can use it against you too (can be disabled in settings)  MANA CORE VALUES - Small Mana Core: 50 silver (F-E ranks) - Mana Core: 150 silver (D-C ranks) - Big Mana Core: 500 silver (B-A ranks) - Huge Mana Core: 1500 silver (S-SSS ranks)  COMPATIBILITY - Combat Extended, Vanilla Expanded, VPE compatible - Safe to add mid-save - Royalty DLC: Optional (adds psychic stat bonuses) - Ideology, Biotech, Anomaly: Fully compatible  REQUIREMENTS - Harmony  See Steam Workshop page for full details!  Made by Jelly Creative

desc: [h1][b]Mythic Ages: Megafauna Bestiary(神话纪元：巨型生物图鉴)的简体中文汉化包，请在原mod之后加载。[/b][/h1]  	翻译： 	-简中：白咕咕  	[h1]简介：[/h1] 	《神话纪元：巨型生物图鉴》为环世界的野生生态系统增添了庞然巨物般的史前与近神话生物。灵感源自广袤的寒带与温带森林，这本图鉴将已灭绝的掠食者、泰坦级的食草动物以及独特进化的野兽引入你的游戏世界。每只生物都经过精心设计，拥有独特的行为模式、资源产出，并在部落和中世纪殖民地中扮演特定角色。  	完全兼容 1.6 版本更新特性。  	神话纪元中的生物并非背景点缀，它们是堪比“敲击兽”的巨兽——危险且足以定义生态系统。 	每一种生物的设计都旨在提供高价值回报：稀有副产品、独特的制作选项或强大的战斗特质——但伴随而来的，是需要权衡的战略成本。  	[h2]狩猎，而非点击[/h2] 	这些生物绝非点一下按钮就能轻松猎杀。 	你需要周密计划、布置陷阱并巧妙站位才能将其击倒。 	你投入的策略越多，应得的回报就越大。  	[h2]生存的代价[/h2] 	有些生物是大胃袋，永远饥肠辘辘。 	有些则极难驯服。 	有些会猎杀我们的小人。 	还有些则需要持续的喂养、巨大的空间或无微不至的照料，一旦管理不善便会成为沉重的负担。  	[h2]生态协同[/h2] 	本模组旨在与[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3472275628]Dark Ages: Beasts and Monsters(黑暗纪元：野兽与怪物)[/url]以及中世纪/部落生态库中的其他生物模组协同运作，丰富你的生物群落多样性，避免内容重复。 	如果说《黑暗纪元》侧重于低魔恐怖怪物，那么《神话纪元》则引入了更具新石器时代和部落风格的一层生态。在这里，野兽是生存、神话传说和资源循环的一部分，而不仅仅是威胁。 	二者共同构建了一个世界，让每一个生物群落都充满生机，并由那些令人既畏惧又崇敬的巨兽所塑造。  	[h2]致谢[/h2] 	本模组的存在，直接得益于SirVan卓越作品的启发。他的模组在概念、结构和美学上为《神话纪元》奠定了基石，助其形成了独特的风貌。衷心感谢他的创造力、远见以及他所构建的世界。 	同时特别感谢为本项目提供核心支持的模组框架开发者们： 	Harmony – 实现了深层次的代码修补。 	Vanilla Expanded Framework – 提供了强大的模块化集成支持。 	感谢环世界模组社区分享的知识、创造力与持续的支持，也感谢不断拓展游戏可能性的玩家们。  	[h2]愿景[/h2] 	《神话纪元》旨在扩展围绕环世界原版的巨型生物（比如标志性的巨懒）的生态系统，提供更多在体型和玩法深度上都能与之比肩的生物。 	每一种动物不仅被设计为存在于地图上，更能与环境和小人进行有意义的互动——影响生态系统、资源流动、制作系统以及突发叙事。 	这是一个持续开发的项目。更多野兽、机制和稀有副产品正在设计和测试中。平衡性调整、新生物和附加功能即将到来。 	敬请关注《神话纪元：巨型生物图鉴》未来的更新及更多内容！

name: Vanilla Cooking Expanded - Bakery
author: Sarg Bjornson, Oskar Potocki, Chowder, Isorex
desc: Vanilla Cooking Expanded – Decorative Baking Module introduces the world of creative baking to RimWorld, expanding your colony’s culinary artistry beyond savory meals and into the realm of sweet, hand-crafted confections.  At the heart of this module lies the new Bakery Oven, where colonists can bake cookies, cupcakes, and donuts—each confection a small masterpiece of color and craftsmanship. These aren’t just sweets, however. Each confection carries a unique emotional touch: eating them helps colonists let go of their worst negative memories, soothing their minds through the simple joy of decorated treats.  Simple, Fine, Lavish, and Gourmet Confections differ not just in flavor, but in how impactful the removed memories are.  The mod is fully configurable through mod options, allowing players to tailor the mechanics to their needs and preference.

name: Vanilla Cooking Expanded - Haute
author: Sarg Bjornson, Oskar Potocki
desc: Vanilla Cooking Expanded - Haute Module is a new addition to the Vanilla Cooking Expanded arsenal, utilising the various mechanics added by Vanilla Cooking Expanded mod. In Haute Meals, players will gain access to a brand new cooking station called electric haute section that will be utilised in creating the most exquisite of dishes, eclipsing even gourmet meals. 	 "Haute Meal" or "Haute Cuisine" is a perfect tier above Gourmet, fitting naturally into a hierarchy of meal quality. "Haute" comes from haute cuisine, which refers to the pinnacle of refined, meticulously prepared, and artistically presented food—often associated with Michelin-star restaurants, aristocratic dining, or even futuristic culinary innovations.  It conveys extreme attention to detail, rare ingredients, and a level of craftsmanship beyond mere "gourmet."  Haute meals take extremely long to make - they are the artworks of culinary arts. They often take a better part of the day to cook, and can only really be cooked efficiently by the real culinary masters - level 20 cooks.  Haute meals are the biggest waste of resources. They not only waste the time, but they also waste the nutrition in a never-seen-before ways. Realistically, only the most advanced and luxurious colonies will be cooking the haute meals.  Haute meals share a lot of similarities with art - they have quality, and depending on the quality, they will have different effects. They also have art descriptions - except it’s a dish description. These descriptions will generate to talk in detail about ingredients used and the flavor profiles they create, as well as what methods were used to achieve such a dish.  Haute meals provide the strongest mood buff when eaten - and the best part is, the mood thought is a unique mood thought for the individual dish, and eating several of these dishes will add up as individual mood thoughts. This means that a colonist might have three different mood thoughts from three different haute dishes they ate.  Additionally, haute dishes also create positive memories for other colonists who were there for the experience.  It’s probably not a meal you want to feed your entire colony with, but it’s something you can aspire to make for those special moments around your colony!

name: Vanilla Cooking Expanded - Stews
author: Oskar Potocki, Sarg Bjornson, Chowder
desc: Vanilla Cooking Expanded - Stews is a first sub-module to the new Vanilla Cuisine Expanded mod series. This particular mod introduces medieval stews - which are more nutritious, more expensive soups that are cooked over time on the wood-fired pot.  Ideal for your medieval colonies and long winter nights, these stews remove any debuffs from eating ingredients like insect meat and human meat! Time to sneak some human flesh into your diet.  Bone Apple Tie (sic!).

name: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
author: Oskar Potocki, Sarg Bjornson, Chowder
desc: Vanilla Ideology Expanded is a mini-series of mods aimed at expanding the content in ideology - be it memes, relics and symbols or icons alike. 	 The goal of the Memes and Structures mod is to add unique memes, and… well, structures to your game. For some reason certain obvious choices like Shinto, Taoism and Eldritch were missing from the base DLC, and this mod is here to introduce them to the ideology creation. With unique memes, players will be able to diversify their playthrough every time they play. This should increase longevity of the game and also make it way more unique and personalised.  This mod adds 36 new memes, alongside many new structures, rituals, precepts, specialist roles, items, objects and mechanics. It should greatly expand what Ideology has to offer, and meshes nicely with the rest of the DLC. With Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures you will be able to create powerful psykers that simply love chocolate, a corporate scrap trading business, a fishing republic, a bunch of god-king radicals, mechanoid technocratic union and much, much more.

name: Vanilla Skills Expanded
author: legodude17, Oskar Potocki, Sarg Bjornson
desc: Vanilla Skills Expanded is a new mod that expands on the vanilla skills system by introducing expertise to the extremely broad skill categories that vanilla has. Only 1 expertise per pawn can be gained. Expertise can only be gained in skills with both a passion and more than 15 levels. In addition, other mods can add more to account for their own additions of tasks.  Expertise will allow your pawns to truly excel in specific skills that fit their abilities and backstories. From planet-known roofers and architects to professional chefs and master duelists, this mod aims to add much more character to all the pawns.  Expertise is a permanent choice, so be careful what you pick!  This mod also introduces three new passion types - critical passion, natural passion and apathy!

name: Vanilla Vehicles Expanded - Tier 3
author: Oskar Potocki, xrushha, Smash Phil, Taranchuk, Reann Shepard
desc: Delve deeper into the world of vehicular advancements with the Tier 3 expansion for Vanilla Vehicles Expanded. While the term "Tier 3" might conjure up images of futuristic, sci-fi machines for some, my focus has remained on the creation of highly specialized and rare vehicles that add both depth and dimension to your in-game experience.  The expansion introduces a total of 11 meticulously designed vehicles. From the much-requested mobile artillery and functional refrigerated trucks to the robust tanks equipped with coaxial machine guns, there's a vehicle to suit every need.  Adding a layer of engagement to the gameplay, these vehicles won't be readily available off the bat. They'll be discovered in their wrecked form, scattered across the map. To gain the knowledge and ability to manufacture these vehicles, players must first locate, recover, and restore them to their former glory. While these wrecked treasures can make an appearance on any map type, players will find a higher concentration on those with roads, adding an element of strategy in map selection and exploration.  This mod introduces many new vehicles, including:  Classic Cars: Elevate the spirits of your colonists with these vintage beauties. Not just for show, they serve a functional purpose, boosting morale when used. Supercars: Built for the road, these are the epitome of speed, but only if your colony is connected to destination via roads. Battle Tanks and Infantry Vehicles: Designed for combat, they come equipped with heavy armor and powerful guns. An asset for any colony facing threats. Mobile Artillery: Respond to threats in real-time, raining a variety of shells upon your adversaries. Versatile Helicopters: Meet diverse needs from cargo transport to troop movement with these airborne assets.

name: Vanilla Vehicles Expanded - Upgrades
author: Oskar Potocki, Smash Phil
desc: Elevate your gameplay with the Vanilla Vehicles Expanded - Upgrades, which offers a revolutionary enhancement to your vehicle management in-game. This mod introduces a comprehensive upgrade system that allows players to customize and enhance their vehicles using valuable in-game resources. Here’s what you can expect:  - Tailored Customization: Each vehicle in your fleet can be individually upgraded with unique enhancements, from reinforced armor and engine covers to offroad tires and cargo expansions. - Impactful Choices: Every upgrade comes with significant advantages but requires strategic resource investment, making your decisions impactful as you develop vehicles suited to various tasks. - Dynamic Visuals: Upgrades are not just statistical; they also change the appearance of your vehicles, adding layers like armored treads and upgraded exhaust systems that visually reflect your modifications. - Diverse Enhancements: Choose from a variety of enhancements that boost speed, improve armor, increase cargo capacity, and more, each tailored to different vehicle types, from explorers and haulers to combat-ready tanks.  We’re excited to utilise what Vehicles Framework has to offer, and you can expect more vehicle upgrades to be added to this mod later down the line.

name: 巴尔：国政与邦交
author: 想成为作家的厨师
desc: [h1]巴尔：国政与邦交[/h1] [b]RimWorld 1.6｜简体中文 / English｜Harmony 为唯一硬依赖[/b] [b]世界数据 v18｜货币外交 v14｜司法、宪制与正式外交 v10｜国家经营 v2｜证券市场 v8｜国家事件公报 v2｜心智与人生 v1[/b]  ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  [b]国家不是政党，信仰也不是政党。[/b]  本模组加入独立的邦国政体、政治集团与个人政治倾向系统，并明确区分：  [list] [*][b]Faction[/b]：国家、阵营或政治共同体； [*][b]Ideo[/b]：Ideology DLC 中的信仰、文化与生活规范； [*][b]政治集团[/b]：国家内部的可加入组织，在现代可以是政党，在部落、王朝或军政时代则是氏族会议、宫廷党争、封臣联盟、行会、教团或官僚机构。 [/list]  一个国家可有多个竞争政治集团；信奉同一 Ideo 的小人也能加入不同组织。加入或退出[b]不会改变原版 Ideo[/b]。  [h2]◆ 邦国政治组织系统[/h2]  每个合格的 Humanlike 国家都有一套独立、可保存的政治组织系统；即使采用相同模板，不同国家产生的仍是不同组织。  [list] [*]全国支持率、基层组织度与政治纲领； [*]集团领袖、成员、合法／地下／被禁状态； [*]政治份额、主政集团、执政联盟与国家稳定度； [*]惯例传承、遴选或选举，以及一元统治、分裂、合并、招募与动员。 [/list]  政治份额按“支持率 × 组织度权重”的 D’Hondt 式方法分配，领先集团会寻找立场相近的伙伴组成多数联盟。无专属内容的国家会从通用模板稳定选择组织；设置可控制新建通用国家采用 3～10 个初始模板。  现代政体将这些份额显示为议会席位并定期选举；部落与王朝政体则显示为氏族、朝议或封臣的议政权重，默认依惯例传承，不举行全国政党选举。  [h2]◆ 时代、宪制与跨国网络[/h2]  物质时代与制度传统已经分离：6 个物质时代随科技和玩家完成研究推进，5 种制度传统可以跨时代延续。13 套政府体系组合代表制、继承、成员资格、权力来源、联盟规则、国家能力与连通度，覆盖元老院、氏族邦联、王朝、商人寡头、军政、官僚帝国、神权、一党指导、委员会、议会与网络共同体。  政治组织分为政党、氏族、家族、行会、元老派系、机关、教团、战团、黑客单元、合作节点和秘密结社。不属于单一国家的黑客、互助与地下网络进入跨国／隐秘政治竞技场，跨越 Faction 招募并积累影响、隐秘度、触达和热度。食人习俗等内容作为可叠加的政治经济层，不会把文化戒律错误地当成唯一政体。  [h2]◆ 写实国家运行、历史路径与人物互动[/h2]  国家差异不再只是名称和数值加成，而是由物质条件、制度规则、组织能力、历史遗产与实际人物共同产生：  [list] [*]国家能力拆分为财政、行政、司法、强制、信息、基础设施、公共服务、交通、通讯、档案、人口统计、货币、大众传播、监控、数字身份与计算 16 项；23 类真实建筑按是否存在、运转和供电贡献能力，科技只规定可能上限； [*]国家同时保存传统、王朝、神圣、法律、选举、革命、绩效、军事与网络等合法性来源，以及法定和实际权力分布。两者背离会形成执行积压、统治风险、领土整合不足和通讯延迟； [*]13 种政体各有独立的决策程序、法定人数、通过门槛、行政时滞、否决与紧急命令规则，并会产生继承争议、联盟垮台、宫廷政变、军队哗变、党内清洗、行政崩溃、宪制僵局、分离危机或网络分裂等特有危机； [*]18 项政策均拥有明确目标、工具、承办机关、覆盖对象、推出时滞、执行强度、经常财政成本和能力门槛。界面分别显示覆盖率、服务质量、守法度、损耗、积压、目标进展与财政压力，政策通过不等于政策已经落地； [*]政治集团拥有真实金库、成员与干部、地方支部、青年／工会／议会／武装／宗教／媒体／情报／商业等翼、内部派别和活动档案；拉票、募员、会费、筹款、分配恩庇、互助、党团会议、宣传、抗议、罢工、操练、地下单元、内部选举或清洗会按政体与局势实际发生； [*]王朝与身份制国家保存真实小人血缘、家族与支系、继承主张、指定继承人、摄政、篡位和历代继承记录。领地可成为带领主、自治度、税赋、征召与朝觐义务的封地，行政触达不足会提高欠赋与分离风险； [*]东亚官僚帝国拥有皇室、东宫、诸王、士大夫、台谏、宫禁、外戚与边镇等持久宫廷集团，可进行立储、颁诏、进谏、弹劾、结党、买通宫人、矫诏、栽赃、宴饮下毒、逼宫、废黜与登基；相关结果进入储君、主张、宫禁安全、仪式合法性、党争和罪责存档； [*]欧洲王朝拥有王室、大封臣、教会、骑士团、市民与觊觎者集团，并以授封、效忠、庄园自治、征召和廷议组织领地；册封骑士、授予封地、封建授职、召集等级会议、颁特许状、挑战继承、联姻与加冕均有独立流程； [*]宫廷行为全面接入人格、六轴气质与道德分：高道德人物通常拒绝主动下毒、诬陷或矫诏，被胁迫者会保留低责任，被害者不背负罪责，胁迫者与幕后主使承担完整责任； [*]外交关系除原版好感外，另有战略信任、安全紧张、经济依存、意识形态亲和、文化熟悉、法律可靠、人道信心、情报渗透、公众情绪与威望差十个向量。口头使节、信使、官署公文、电报／无线电、安全电子渠道与网络即时通讯具有不同延迟、可靠性、认证与截获风险； [*]十二类正式条约被拆成可定期复核的双边义务束；新增定期物资救助、商品输送互惠、共同防御与同盟条约。市场准入、过境、非侵略、外交保护、司法协助、引渡人道保证、救灾物流、互惠货运、武装援助和同盟团结会因两国真实能力与履约记录进入履行、吃紧、逾期或违约，而不是永久好感加成； [*]救助与互惠条约允许选择任意可搬运商品、数量和周期；玩家出口从地图真实库存扣除，外国来货生成实体货物，并按可用条件使用《人民与共和国》铁路、航天器或地面交付。每批货运都有保存的起讫点、货单、运输方式、预计抵达与拦截结果； [*]共同防御协议和同盟会在玩家殖民地遭袭时派出带可见番号的盟军支队，真实进驻并攻击敌人；威胁结束后部队离图，进驻与返程均进入“世界物流与兵力动向”； [*]战争授权现在保存“夺取虚拟领地”或“财富掠夺”目标，授权、动员与正式宣战严格分开。战争中积累战果后可要求割地、赔款或无条件投降；领地由虚拟领地系统实际移交，赔款从付款方真实扣除并沿可见货运路线送达； [*]玩家可邀请完成互认、关系良好、政治体系相容且执政党思想相近的国家，建立并自定义命名政治集团、防御联盟或经济共同体。成员与章程写入存档；防御联盟共享共同防御，其他章程强化相应的政治或经济关系向量； [*]选中己方小人并右键另一名 Humanlike，可进行 45 种实体国政互动。右键菜单先按类别折叠，并在显示动作前按时代、宪制、宫廷传统、职务与目标身份过滤；共和国不会再看到上奏、朝觐、立储、登基、册封或加冕。小人会真实走近目标并花费时间，诏书、玉玺、毒酒、罪证、王冠、权杖与册封剑会随动作出现在手部或两人之间； [*]每个 NPC 国家都有确定生成并存档的历史原型、重大转折与路径依赖，历史会影响当代中央化、商业化、识字、军事化、城市化、阶层、政治多元、移民开放与制度记忆。NPC 按接触程度使用完整、战略、区域、抽象或休眠模拟层级，重要国家保持细节，遥远国家不浪费逐人计算。 [/list]  [h2]◆ 每名小人的政治档案[/h2]  实际进入世界的合格 Humanlike 小人会获得：六条连续政治轴、最接近的思潮、对本国各集团的支持度、正式组织归属与最倾向集团，以及加入意愿、参与度、忠诚和风险规避。  小人会按立场、集团实力、组织接触与合法风险自主加入、退出或转投组织；也会讨论政治、招募成员并产生心情与社交反馈。政治组织体系属于 Faction 而非种族，因此多种族殖民地共享玩家国家的同一政治系统。  每名 Humanlike 小人拥有一个不会占用特性栏位的真正核心人格：热情、冷淡、健谈、沉思、果断、慎思、理性、敏感、乐观、忧郁、沉着、冲动、好奇、务实、强势或害羞。六条连续气质轴和有界行为参数会直接进入社交、话量、行动意愿、孤独与其他情感、娱乐、人物共鸣、记忆语气、核心价值、人生模板和政治自主；例如冷淡者不会积累孤独且较少交流，健谈者会显著增加主动社交与闲聊。  成年政治人物通常另从八组对立维度中获得三项性格特质；诚实、公正、忠贞等描述长期品格，不再冒充整个人格。人物卡和开局编辑器会把两层分开显示；普通生成、重新随机和手动选择的特质上限均为三项。正面预设为诚实／公正／忠贞，负面预设为欺瞒／武断／反复；预设只替换本模组性格特质，不删除原版或其他模组特性，也不覆盖核心人格。  [h2]◆ 完整心智、核心价值与人生模块[/h2]  原“共和国人物记忆”现已完整成为《巴尔：国政与邦交》的原生模块：程序集、存档权威、事件采集、独立检查标签、Defs、双语文本和界面资源均由本模组承载。旧存档继续识别原类型名和公开 API；载入时会按玩家设置的上限整理详细年表，而累计索引、人物看法与物品偏好继续保留。即使不启用《巴尔：人民与共和国》，所有 Humanlike 仍能使用完整系统。  每个人都拥有 16 项完整核心价值——真实、公正、恻隐、团结、自由、秩序、忠诚、传统、求知、劳动、成就、安全、亲族、共同体、守护责任与愉悦——以及饮食、劳作、社交、娱乐、审美、舒适、财富、自然、动物、技术、阅读、艺术、武力、冒险、权威、政治、远行和照护 18 类人物喜好。固有部分由核心人格、性格特质、原版特质、成长经历、技能热情与 Ideology 共同形成；后天部分只被真实经历缓慢、有限地修正，不能由一次事件覆盖整个人格。  “我所见即我所思，我所思即我所行”现在是一条可保存、可检查的完整链：人物真实感知到的事件和原版思想先经过核心价值评估，形成当前意图；随后真实开始的工作、娱乐、饮食、社交、购物或政治行动会回填行动结果和价值—行动一致度。玩家命令始终有效；自主娱乐、食物选择、社交、消费和政治行动会受到人物喜好、价值观与经历的有限影响。  完整人生模板不再是静态简介。它会组合成长经历、所属共同体、信仰、最强能力、人生阶段、十类人生原型、首要原则、社会角色、长期方向、近期目标、眼前关切和下一意图，并只以真实重大经历建立可核验的人生章节。选中小人后，可在与“健康”“角色”同列的“心智与人生”按钮中打开八页完整档案：人物总览、思维链、核心价值、人物喜好、人生模板、完整过往、人物看法与事物看法；原版角色页不再被加宽。整个系统无需生成式 AI 或网络。  模组设置提供“每名人物”与“整个存档”两层详细记忆上限；默认分别为 1,024 条与 24,000 条。超出上限的旧细节会归入一生索引，累计次数和已经形成的人物／事物看法继续保留。详细年表以 GZip 紧凑块保存；旧版冗长 XML 存档在载入并再次保存后自动转换。  人物喜好页会把真实吃过的食物、接触过的人和经历过的其他物品按喜欢／讨厌明确分栏：物品沿用原版图标，人物显示肖像，并列出最近食用／经历时间、累计次数、主要原因与最近证据。长译文、思维链和人生章节均按实际文字高度排版，不会再遮掉末行。  恋爱、订婚、结婚、怀孕、实际生产、每年／里程碑生日、吃到喜欢的食物和看见喜欢的物品都会生成对应正面记忆、心情与喜悦；亲近朋友可以分享快乐并形成庆祝、陪伴或赠礼意图。  所有口头社交实时读取双方说话与听觉能力。失去舌头或语言器官后不再伪装成正常闲聊、劝说或政治对白；善意互动会先显示“……”，再按实时移动与操作能力演出走近、面向、点头、握手／轻触、拥抱、安静陪坐或递交实体礼物，并为双方留下各自视角的长期记忆。  [h2]◆ 建国、内阁与详细政策[/h2]  殖民地首先是临时聚落；达到可配置的人口与时间门槛后，可以召开建国大会并建立完整政府。  [list] name: GUILD FACTION ADD-ON - Isekai RPG Leveling
author: Poupun
desc: THE ADVENTURERS' GUILD — Isekai RPG Leveling add-on  Turns the Adventurers' Guild from a flavor mention in the base mod into an actual faction you run into on the world map. They send hunts to your quest board, raid you if you cross them, and at high reputation their hero might pay your colony a visit.   THE GUILD ITSELF  One world faction with a single procedurally-built Guild Hall settlement: throne alcove on a carpet, banquet aisle flanked by stone pillars, barracks wing with end-tables between the beds, armory wing lined with weapon racks and a forge, lit plaza out front.  40 named members, every rank from F to SSS: - Arthur "Excalibur" the Hero (SSS) — strongest member, not the leader - Magnus "the Sage" Pendrak — Guild Master (SS), the actual leader - 5 S, 6 A, 8 B, 8 C, 6 D, 3 E, 2 F filling out the ranks  Every guild member wears the same grey uniform — plate armor on medieval scenarios, flak vest on industrial, with a duster on top for A-rank and above. No helmets, no random clown apparel.   QUESTS  Daily Quest Board with its own UI. Click the gizmo on the Guild Hall to open it. Five rolling hunt/expedition/raid contracts that scale to your strongest pawn. New listings every in-game day.  Recruitment Duel (unlocks at +25 goodwill). A Guild adventurer walks onto your map and challenges you to a duel. Beat them down to 40% health or knock them out, they defect and join your colony. Kill them and the Guild takes note.  Hero's Visit (unlocks at +75 goodwill). Arthur and three companions stop by for three in-game days as honored guests. Keep him content with food, beds, and a clean room and the Guild pays you generously on departure. Let his mood collapse and he leaves in disgust. Let him die and the entire faction goes permanently hostile, with the surviving three turning on your colony as a raid.   PLAYS NICE WITH  Vanilla, Royalty, Ideology, Biotech, Anomaly. When Royalty is loaded, plate armor is preferred over flak so the Guild looks period-correct in medieval games. Existing saves work — the roster generates on first load. Tick loops are throttled, no LINQ in hot paths, no patches on common stat methods.   REQUIREMENTS  - Harmony - Isekai RPG Leveling (base mod)   Made by Jelly Creative.

The item is no longer destroyed upon failure; instead, there is a chance for the refinement level to be reduced by 2 (replacing the original destroy penalty), otherwise it is reduced by 1.  - Enabled Crafting Bonus: The original mod included a mechanism where crafting skill increases success rates, but it was left unimplemented. desc: [h1]✨ Research Reinvented 汉化补丁 (活跃维护中)[/h1]  [h2]📜 汉化声明与版权说明[/h2] [list] [*][b]原 MOD 版权：[/b]归原作者所有，本汉化仅提供中文翻译。 [*][b]内容来源：[/b]版式参考当前汉化页面，功能信息以原 MOD 与配套 MOD 页面说明为准。 [*][b]反馈渠道：[/b]如有漏翻或错译，欢迎在创意工坊评论区反馈。 [/list]  [hr][/hr]  [h2]⚠️ 注意事项[/h2] [list] [*][b]加载顺序：[/b]本汉化必须排在 [b]Research Reinvented[/b] 与其配套内容之后加载。 [*][b]配套建议：[/b]建议同时订阅 [b]Research Reinvented: Stepping Stones[/b] 以获得完整科技树体验。 [*][b]兼容版本：[/b]支持 RimWorld 1.3 / 1.4 / 1.5 / 1.6。 [/list]  [hr][/hr]  [h2]🚀 核心功能简介（Research Reinvented）[/h2] [list] [*][b]研究流程重做：[/b]不再仅靠研究台挂机，可通过多种行动共同推进科技。 [*][b]逆向与遗迹：[/b]可对缴获设备逆向工程，或从古代遗迹中提取知识。 [*][b]实验与材料：[/b]通过材料分析、实验测试与设计改造获取研究进展。 [*][b]原型验证：[/b]可建造原型进行先期验证，再逐步完善为正式成果。 [*][b]情报来源：[/b]可通过外交信息交换或囚犯知识提取补充科研线索。 [*][b]社交研究：[/b]殖民者社交互动中的头脑风暴也能贡献研究点。 [*][b]后备理论研究：[/b]若无可用研究机会，将回退到理论研究模式，速度可在设置中调整。 [/list]  [hr][/hr]  [h2]🛠️ 科技树扩展（Stepping Stones）[/h2] [list] [*][b]科技树重排：[/b]将原版研究树改为更细分、更连贯的渐进式结构。 [*][b]电力拆分：[/b]电力相关课题拆分为加热元件、发电机、电力基础与电路等阶段。 [*][b]前置链完善：[/b]为原版科技补充逻辑前置，减少“孤立科技”与跨级跳跃。 [*][b]时代层级校正：[/b]后期高端科技被放置到更合理的科技等级与位置。 [*][b]依赖关系细化：[/b]更多技术依赖具体前置，而不再集中挂在少数总线科技下。 [*][b]医疗门槛：[/b]器官/肢体植入手术增加早期医疗前置，且提供可在设置中关闭的选项。 [*][b]独立性：[/b]可单独使用；同时安装主模组时体验更完整。 [/list]  [hr][/hr]  [h2]🧭 使用要点[/h2] [list] [*][b]自动执行：[/b]大多数研究行为可自动进行，殖民者会按系统机制推进。 [*][b]手动指定：[/b]原型建造与相关任务需要像普通建造/生产一样手动下达。 [*][b]囚犯选项：[/b]需在囚犯标签中启用对应知识提取选项。 [*][b]外交交换：[/b]与中立势力交换信息需要消耗好感，结盟后可免费。 [*][b]科研包制作：[/b]简易科研包在手工点/裁缝台制作，高级科研包在加工台制作。 [/list]  [hr][/hr]  [h2]❓ 常见问题[/h2] [quote] [b]Q: 可以中途加入现有存档吗？[/b] A: 可以，通常可直接加入。  [b]Q: 可以从现有存档移除吗？[/b] A: 一般可以，但可能出现少量一次性报错。  [b]Q: 与其他 MOD 兼容吗？[/b] A: 大多数仅新增课题或调整显示的 MOD 可直接兼容；深度重写研究系统的 MOD 建议单独测试。  [b]Q: 与 CE、ResearchPal、Semi Random Research、Dubs' Mint Menus 兼容吗？[/b] A: 原页面说明为兼容。  [b]Q: 支持多人模式吗？[/b] A: 原作者未全面测试，社区反馈为可用。 [/quote]  [hr][/hr]  [h2]🔗 包含内容[/h2] [list] [*]Research Reinvented（主模组） [*]Research Reinvented: Stepping Stones（配套科技树模组） [/list]
